goals.description: Rafa Llorente headed the ball on to Felipe Mora, who finished with his left foot from very close range into the bottom right corner.
Querétaro's Daniel Parra turned the ball into his own net to double Atlético de San Luis's lead.
Ali Avila converted the penalty with a right-footed shot into the high centre of the goal after Benjamín Galdames fouled substitute Denilson Muñoz.

var.detail: VAR decision: no penalty for Atlético de San Luis

Half-time substitute Federico Viñas took Helinho's pass and scored with a left-footed shot from the centre of the box into the bottom right corner.
On a fast break Nicolás Castro found Helinho, who finished left-footed from the centre of the box into the bottom left corner.
Following a corner, Rafael Fernández set up Jonathan Padilla, who struck a right-footed shot from the centre of the box into the top right corner.

goals.description: Brian Rodríguez set up Miguel Borja, who finished with his right foot from the centre of the box into the bottom right corner.
Two minutes later Carlos Álvarez found Érick Sánchez on the left side of the box and he scored with a left-footed shot into the centre of the goal.
América countered and Alejandro Zendejas laid the ball off to Brian Rodríguez, who hit a right-footed shot from outside the box into the centre of the goal.
Alejandro Zendejas made it 4-0 with a left-footed shot from the centre of the box into the top left corner.
Luís Esteves converted a penalty, awarded after a VAR review for a Santiago Bueno handball, with a right-footed shot into the top right corner.
Sergio Hernandez teed up Ryan Mmaee, who scored with a right-footed shot from outside the box into the bottom right corner.
A minute later Kevin Álvarez restored América's three-goal margin with a right-footed finish from very close range into the bottom right corner.

var.detail: Penalty awarded to Atlas after a VAR review for a handball by América's Santiago Bueno
